title: Who are the biggest global pharmaceutical companies?
paragraphs: BCC Research has named Pfizer as the leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturer in the world. With pharmaceutical revenues of $79,557 million and a market share of 6%, this titan force is one to be reckoned with.
At number two is the China National Pharmaceutical Group Corporation. The CNPGC had revenues of $58,447 million in 2021, and held a market share of 4.4%.
AbbVie, with revenues of $56,601 and a market share of 4.2%, is ranked by BCC Research as the third largest pharmaceutical company.
In 2021, Novartis enjoyed global revenues of $52,601 and a market share of 4%.
At number five is Johnson & Johnson, who made $52,080 million in revenues in 2021 with a market share of 3.9%.
In 2021, Roche made revenues of $49,279 million and had a market share of 3.7%.
With global revenues of $45,055 in 2021, BMS ranks as the seventh biggest manufacturer of pharmaceutical drugs.
Their market share stood at 2.8% in 2021, and the company enjoyed revenues of $36,541 million.
Sanofi comes in at number ten, with revenues of $31,879 million and a market share of 2.4%.
